name: Calangute Beach
description: Shoreline paths, coastal conditions and lifeguard access.

properties.name: Calangute North Danger Zone (Sep 5 spike)
properties.description: ML-predicted rip current danger zone, activated when wave height and current speed cross threshold values.

properties.name: Calangute South Danger Zone (Sep 12 spike)
properties.description: ML-predicted rip current danger zone, activated when wave height and current speed cross threshold values.

properties.name: Calangute Central Known Rip-Current-Prone Stretch
properties.description: Historically rip-current-prone stretch based on published coastal research for the Sinquerim-Candolim-Calangute-Baga coastal belt. Not tied to a specific timestamp; represents baseline elevated risk used to weight ML predictions.

properties.name: Calangute North Swimming Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-supervised designated swim area, marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags, near the northern stretch of the beach.

properties.name: Calangute South Swimming Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-supervised designated swim area, marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags, near the southern stretch of the beach.

properties.name: Calangute North-Central Restricted Zone (Water Sports Channel)
properties.description: Approximate no-swim zone around the water sports boat channel (jet skis, parasailing, banana boats), marked in reality by black-and-white flags. Fast boat traffic makes this stretch dangerous for swimmers.

properties.name: Calangute South-Central Restricted Zone (Water Sports Channel)
properties.description: Approximate no-swim zone around a second water sports boat channel, marked in reality by black-and-white flags. Fast boat traffic makes this stretch dangerous for swimmers.

properties.name: Calangute North Safe Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-monitored swim zone near the main Calangute beach entrance / Beach Road junction. Marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags roughly 100m apart.

properties.name: Calangute South Safe Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-monitored swim zone toward the southern stretch of Calangute beach, closer to the Candolim border. Marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags roughly 100m apart.

properties.name: Calangute North Lifeguard Tower
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard tower position near the northern stretch of Calangute beach, close to the Baga border.
properties.operator: Drishti Marine (Dept. of Tourism, Govt. of Goa)

properties.name: Calangute Central Lifeguard Tower
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard tower position near the main beach entrance / Beach Road junction, the busiest tourist stretch.
properties.operator: Drishti Marine (Dept. of Tourism, Govt. of Goa)

properties.name: Calangute South Lifeguard Tower
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard tower position toward the southern stretch of Calangute beach, near the Candolim border.
properties.operator: Drishti Marine (Dept. of Tourism, Govt. of Goa)
